test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 6.
solution: The correct answer is 'scowled.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence "***She stared at my face and ___(6)___***'' is indicating the reason for doing something. • The use of the word ''stared'' in the sentence indicates **to look at somebody or something for a long time because you are surprised, shocked, etc**. • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'scowled'. • The word 'scowled' means **an angry or bad-tempered expression**. • Example:* Ash scowled and told them to get out*.** Hence, the correct answer is option 3. Complete Sentence: *She stared at my face and **scowled***. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ** Let us explore the other options: __ • 'Stooped' means **to bend your head and shoulders forwards and downwards**. (झुकना) • 'Snored**' means **to breathe noisily through your nose and mouth while you are asleep**. (सोते समय खर्राटे भरना) • 'Scared' means **frightened**. (भयभीत) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य "*She stared at my face and ___(6)___*'' कुछ करने के कारण को इंगित कर रहा है। • वाक्य में 'stared' शब्द का प्रयोग** किसी को देर तक देखते रहना; घूरना** है। • इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शब्द 'scowled' है। • 'Scowled' शब्द का अर्थ है **तेवर दिखाना, नाक-भौं सिकोड़ना**। • उदाहरण: *Ash **scowled** and told them to get out*. अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है। पूर्ण वाक्य: *She stared at my face and scowled*. 57:T1ab7, The correct answer is 'reminded.'
